description: Current application schema after the two reviewed cleanup migrations; contains metadata only.

columns.name: phone
columns.check: phone IS NULL OR btrim(phone) = ''::text OR phone ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'::text

columns.name: surname
columns.check: surname IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(surname)) >= 1 AND char_length(btrim(surname)) <= 40

columns.name: force_logout_after
columns.comment: Server-side revocation boundary for member LINE ID tokens. Tokens issued at or before this timestamp are rejected.

columns.name: required_service_ids
columns.comment: Concrete booking_services.id values required to use this point-card reward. Empty array means unrestricted; any one matching service is sufficient.

columns.name: required_service_match_mode
columns.comment: How required_service_ids are matched: any = at least one selected service is booked; all = every selected service is booked.

columns.name: required_service_ids
columns.comment: Concrete booking_services.id values required to use this event ticket. Empty array means unrestricted; any one matching service is sufficient.

columns.name: required_service_match_mode
columns.comment: How required_service_ids are matched: any = at least one selected service is booked; all = every selected service is booked.

columns.name: price_amount
columns.comment: Current service price in whole TWD dollars. Server-side booking creation is authoritative.

columns.name: service_type
columns.check: service_type IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(service_type)) >= 1 AND char_length(btrim(service_type)) <= 80
columns.comment: Administrator-defined service type used to warn members when multiple selected services share a type.

columns.name: counts_toward_membership
columns.comment: Whether this service may count toward member accumulated paid service minutes. System in-store service is false.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.comment: Soft-delete timestamp. Deleted services remain for historical booking references but are excluded from admin/member selection.

columns.name: deleted_by
columns.comment: LINE user id of the administrator that soft-deleted the service.

columns.name: requires_companion_service
columns.comment: When true, this service is an add-on and cannot be the only non-system service selected by one booking participant.

columns.name: cancellation_requested_at
columns.comment: When a member requested cancellation. Booking status remains pending/confirmed until admin review.

columns.name: cancellation_requested_by
columns.comment: LINE user id that requested cancellation.

columns.name: cancellation_source_status
columns.comment: Booking status at cancellation request time; used to preserve the reservation until review.

columns.name: cancellation_decision
columns.comment: Admin review decision: approved or rejected.

columns.name: start_at
columns.default_value:
((booking_date + start_time) +
CASE
    WHEN starts_next_day THEN '1 day'::interval
    ELSE '00:00:00'::interval
END)

columns.name: end_at
columns.default_value:
(((booking_date + start_time) +
CASE
    WHEN starts_next_day THEN '1 day'::interval
    ELSE '00:00:00'::interval
END) + make_interval(mins => total_duration_minutes))

columns.name: work_start_time
columns.check: EXTRACT(second FROM work_start_time) = 0::numeric AND (EXTRACT(minute FROM work_start_time)::integer % 5) = 0

columns.name: work_end_time
columns.check: EXTRACT(second FROM work_end_time) = 0::numeric AND (EXTRACT(minute FROM work_end_time)::integer % 5) = 0

columns.name: min_advance_days
columns.comment: Global minimum number of days members must book in advance. Applies to all booking services.

columns.name: booking_notice
columns.comment: Member-facing booking instructions. Plain text; line breaks are preserved by clients.

columns.name: max_advance_days
columns.comment: Maximum number of days from today that a member may book. 0 means unlimited.

columns.name: unit_price_amount
columns.comment: Price snapshot in whole TWD dollars captured when the booking item is created.

columns.name: service_type
columns.check: service_type IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(service_type)) >= 1 AND char_length(btrim(service_type)) <= 80

columns.name: counts_toward_membership
columns.comment: Immutable booking-item snapshot. False items must never be included in member paid service-minute totals or tier progress.

tables.name: public.booking_service_types
tables.comment: Administrator-managed canonical booking service types used by the booking service dropdown.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Canonical service type label. Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-trimmed.

columns.name: created_by
columns.comment: Server-written provenance. qa:e2e:* marks disposable E2E fixture service types.

columns.name: max_tickets_per_redemption
columns.comment: Maximum point-card tickets per redemption; 0 means no business quantity limit.

columns.name: expiry_mode
columns.comment: Fixed ticket validity mode: month_end, week_end, days_after_issue, or fixed_date.

columns.name: expiry_date
columns.comment: Absolute valid-through date when expiry_mode = fixed_date.

columns.name: expiry_days
columns.comment: Inclusive calendar-day validity starting from the scheduled issue date when expiry_mode = days_after_issue.

columns.name: start_at
columns.default_value:
((booking_date + start_time) +
CASE
    WHEN starts_next_day THEN '1 day'::interval
    ELSE '00:00:00'::interval
END)

columns.name: end_at
columns.default_value:
(((booking_date + end_time) +
CASE
    WHEN starts_next_day THEN '1 day'::interval
    ELSE '00:00:00'::interval
END) +
CASE
    WHEN (end_time <= start_time) THEN '1 day'::interval
    ELSE '00:00:00'::interval
END)

columns.name: maintenance_enabled
columns.comment: Global user-surface maintenance gate. When true, all member-facing surfaces are blocked, including test sessions.

columns.name: allow_pc_test_login
columns.comment: Allow desktop/PC user surfaces to enter direct test-account login while system maintenance and test mode are both enabled.

columns.name: allow_mobile_test_login
columns.comment: Allow mobile/tablet user surfaces to enter direct test-account login while system maintenance and test mode are both enabled.

columns.name: maintenance_revoked_after
columns.comment: Global revocation boundary set when maintenance transitions from off to on. Non-admin LINE tokens issued at or before this timestamp remain revoked after maintenance ends.

columns.name: admin_line_user_id
columns.comment: Legacy source admin for sessions created before direct test-account login. Nullable for direct test sessions.

columns.name: device_class
columns.comment: Device class on which the direct test session was issued: pc or mobile.

tables.name: public.member_presence_sessions
tables.comment: Server-authenticated current member presence sessions. Historical online/offline events remain in audit_logs.

columns.name: last_seen_at
columns.comment: Heartbeat timestamp used to determine whether a member is currently online.

tables.name: public.automation_test_runs
tables.comment: Server-authenticated automated QA test runs. Never stores secrets or full tokens.

tables.name: public.automation_test_cases
tables.comment: Domain-level cases belonging to an automated QA test run.

tables.name: public.automation_test_steps
tables.comment: Observable steps and expected/actual safe snapshots for automated QA cases.

tables.name: public.booking_receipts
tables.comment: Private booking receipt snapshots. Bound receipts are retained for the lifecycle of the booking record; deleting the booking cascades the receipt row and enqueues the Storage object for deletion. Pending uploads older than 24 hours are expired and enqueued for cleanup.

columns.name: max_tickets_per_day
columns.comment: Maximum event tickets per Asia/Taipei business date; 0 means no business quantity limit.

tables.name: public.test_execution_leases
tables.comment: Short-lived server-only leases preventing test-data purge while a full browser E2E is executing.
